title: Rankings & Recognition
heroSubheading: A public, NUC-accredited university established in 2008 by the Taraba State Government to widen access to university education and drive economic growth in Taraba State and across Nigeria.
rankingsIntro: Taraba State University’s research output is tracked internationally by the AD Scientific Index, which ranks institutions by the productivity and citation impact of their researchers.
rankingsMethodNote: The H-index measures both how much a university’s scholars publish and how often that work is cited by other researchers. It is a widely used indicator of sustained research influence. The AD Scientific Index builds institutional rankings from the public research profiles of affiliated scholars.

highlights.title: International visibility
highlights.text: The work of TSU researchers is indexed alongside that of universities worldwide, giving the institution a measurable place in global research rankings.

highlights.title: Growing research community
highlights.text: More than a hundred TSU academics have public research profiles tracking their publications, citations and H-index.

highlights.title: Postgraduate training
highlights.text: TSU awards postgraduate diplomas, master’s and doctoral degrees. Its first PhD graduate was Dr Hanawa Herbert Rufus.

strengthsIntro: Areas where TSU researchers are most active, based on the subject profile of the university’s researchers on the AD Scientific Index and the published work of its academic staff.

researchStrengths.title: Agriculture & Forestry
researchStrengths.description: One of the two largest subject groups among TSU’s indexed researchers, including animal science and animal nutrition. This builds on the state’s agricultural base.

researchStrengths.title: Natural Sciences
researchStrengths.description: An equally large group, including plant ecophysiology and ecology of Nigerian savanna and freshwater ecosystems.

researchStrengths.title: Communication & Media
researchStrengths.description: Research on health communication, gender and the media, new media, conflict reporting and risk, published in international journals.

researchStrengths.title: Environment & Geography
researchStrengths.description: TETFund-supported studies of flood risk in the River Benue basin, river pollution around Jalingo, deforestation in Kurmi and soil erosion in the River Lamurde catchment.

researchStrengths.title: Social Sciences, Security & Economics
researchStrengths.description: Research on national security, economics and public policy, including a TETFund-funded study of kidnapping and its implications for Nigeria’s security.

researchStrengths.title: Entrepreneurship & Innovation
researchStrengths.description: Practical skills, entrepreneurship and innovation, based at the new Entrepreneurship Institute and its ICT Centre.

awardsIntro: Recognition of the university and its leadership at national and international level.

awards.title: New faculties established
awards.description: The Faculties of Computing and Artificial Intelligence, and of Religion and Philosophy, were established alongside new undergraduate and postgraduate programmes and international academic collaborations.

awards.title: National Merit Award for Best Vice-Chancellor, North East
awards.description: Presented to Prof. Sunday Paul Bako. He was also named Best Performing Vice-Chancellor of the Year by Rotaract Club District 9125 in 2018.

awards.title: Ranked internationally for research impact
awards.description: TSU is placed 7,686th in the world by H-index in the AD Scientific Index 2027 edition. uniRank 2026 places it 91st in Nigeria.

awards.title: NUC resource verification for four new media programmes
awards.description: Advertising, Broadcasting, Journalism and Media Studies, and Public Relations. This follows the unbundling of Mass Communication.

awards.title: Entrepreneurship Institute commissioned
awards.description: Funded through the NEDC and commissioned by the Minister of State for Regional Development, the facility includes conference halls and an ICT Centre with 50 computers.

awards.title: TETFund National Research Fund award
awards.description: Dr Chama Felix Adanaa was awarded an NRF grant in the 2024 cycle as Principal Researcher. The Federal Government approved the cycle’s 158 projects in August 2025.

awards.title: TETFund ICT Experience Centre
awards.description: A major digital infrastructure project under the TETFund 2024 intervention.

awards.title: Full NUC accreditation for Mass Communication
First convocation
awards.description: 5,900 graduates from five sets. The university has since produced its first PhD graduate.

scholarsIntro: A selection of TSU academics with public research profiles and recognised contributions to their fields.

scholars.name: Prof. Sunday Paul Bako
scholars.summary: A botanist and professor since 2006, with more than 120 publications on plant stress physiology and aquatic ecosystems in Nigerian savannas. He is a member of the Botanical Society of Nigeria and the Ecological Society of Nigeria.

scholars.name: Dr Chama Felix Adanaa
scholars.summary: Principal Researcher on a TETFund National Research Fund grant awarded in the 2024 cycle. The NRF is TETFund’s nationally competitive research fund.

scholars.name: Oguntoye Mutiu
scholars.summary: Researches animal nutrition. Listed among TSU’s ranked researchers on the AD Scientific Index.

scholars.name: Abubakar Jibril
scholars.summary: Researches health communication, gender and the media, new media, conflict reporting and risk. Listed among TSU’s ranked researchers on the AD Scientific Index.
